entities.name: MinC P57845
observations: Exact 225-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt P57845 from Pasteurella multocida; predicted cell-division inhibitor affecting polar Z-ring formation.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 25.21 kDa, pI 7.19, GRAVY 0.010; no catalytic reaction retrieved.

entities.name: FtsZ
observations: MinC reference annotation describes inhibition of FtsZ polymerization and destabilization of polar FtsZ filaments.
